title: 1975 nuclear base incursions cable to the Pentagon

plain: In 1975, unknown objects intruded over US nuclear weapons bases, says the researcher Marik von Rennenkampff, and a military cable, a formal message sent to the Pentagon, recorded the incidents. He urges Michels to read the cable for himself and mentions John Greenewald Jr., a man known for collecting government records. If true, it would mean the military itself wrote down unexplained visits to its most sensitive sites.
